glossary.definition: (A) "Ancillary service" means a hospital item or service that a hospital customarily provides as part of a shoppable service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Chargemaster" means the list maintained by a hospital of each hospital item or service for which the hospital has established a charge.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "De-identified maximum negotiated charge" means the highest charge that a hospital has negotiated with all third-party payors for a hospital item or service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "De-identified minimum negotiated charge" means the lowest charge that a hospital has negotiated with all third-party payors for a hospital item or service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Discounted cash price" means the charge that applies to an individual who pays cash, or a cash equivalent, for a hospital item or service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Federal price transparency law" means section 2718(e) of the "Public Health Service Act," 42 U.S.C. 300gg-18, and hospital price transparency rules adopted by the United States department of health and human services and the United States centers for medicare and medicaid services implementing that section, including the rules and requirements under 45 C.F.R. 180.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Hospital" has the same meaning as in section 3722.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Gross charge" means the charge for a hospital item or service that is reflected on a hospital's chargemaster, absent any discounts.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Machine-readable format" means a digital representation of information in a file that can be imported or read into a computer system for further processing. "Machine-readable format" includes.XML,.JSON, and.CSV formats.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (K) "Payor-specific negotiated charge" means the charge that a hospital has negotiated with a third-party payor for a hospital item or service.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (M) "Process" or "processing" means any operation or set of operations that are performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means, including the collection, use, storage, disclosure, analysis, deletion, transfer, or modification of personal data.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (M) "Process" or "processing" means any operation or set of operations that are performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means, including the collection, use, storage, disclosure, analysis, deletion, transfer, or modification of personal data.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (N) "Publicly available information" means information that is lawfully made available from federal, state, or local government records or widely available media.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (O) "Service package" means an aggregation of individual hospital items or services into a single service with a single charge.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (P) "Shoppable service" means a service that may be scheduled by a health care consumer in advance.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3727.31 to 3727.40 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(S) "Third-party payor" means an entity that is, by statute, contract, or agreement, legally responsible for payment of a claim for a hospital item or service.
